title: InferenceInputPayload
description: JSON payload schema accepted by the SIH26103 early-warning inference endpoint for a single infrastructure project snapshot.

project_id.description: Unique official MoSPI Project ID (metadata identifier, not passed into ML estimators).

project_name.example: Integrated Terminal Building at Vijayawada Airport

features.description: Exact 36 SAFE_MVP model features required for prediction.

original_cost.description: Numerical feature: original_cost. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

approval_to_start_months.description: Numerical feature: approval_to_start_months. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

cumulative_expenditure.description: Numerical feature: cumulative_expenditure. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

expenditure_percent_of_original_cost.description: Numerical feature: expenditure_percent_of_original_cost. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

monthly_expenditure_change.description: Numerical feature: monthly_expenditure_change. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

monthly_expenditure_growth_pct.description: Numerical feature: monthly_expenditure_growth_pct. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

physical_progress_pct.description: Numerical feature: physical_progress_pct. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

monthly_progress_change.description: Numerical feature: monthly_progress_change. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

progress_growth_rate.description: Numerical feature: progress_growth_rate. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

planned_duration_months.description: Numerical feature: planned_duration_months. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

elapsed_months.description: Numerical feature: elapsed_months. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

remaining_planned_months.description: Numerical feature: remaining_planned_months. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

elapsed_duration_ratio.description: Numerical feature: elapsed_duration_ratio. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

is_past_original_doc.description: Numerical feature: is_past_original_doc. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

efficiency_gap.description: Numerical feature: efficiency_gap. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

cost_physical_ratio.description: Numerical feature: cost_physical_ratio. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

expected_progress_pct.description: Numerical feature: expected_progress_pct. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

progress_gap_pct_points.description: Numerical feature: progress_gap_pct_points. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

physical_progress_1_month_change.description: Numerical feature: physical_progress_1_month_change. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

physical_progress_2_month_change.description: Numerical feature: physical_progress_2_month_change. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

expenditure_1_month_change.description: Numerical feature: expenditure_1_month_change. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

expenditure_2_month_change.description: Numerical feature: expenditure_2_month_change. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

progress_trend_slope.description: Numerical feature: progress_trend_slope. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

expenditure_trend_slope.description: Numerical feature: expenditure_trend_slope. If missing or null, imputed with training median.

negative_expenditure_flag.description: Binary quality/schedule flag: negative_expenditure_flag. 1 if active, 0 otherwise.

missing_previous_month_flag.description: Binary quality/schedule flag: missing_previous_month_flag. 1 if active, 0 otherwise.

invalid_duration_flag.description: Binary quality/schedule flag: invalid_duration_flag. 1 if active, 0 otherwise.

past_original_doc_flag.description: Binary quality/schedule flag: past_original_doc_flag. 1 if active, 0 otherwise.

missing_key_date_flag.description: Binary quality/schedule flag: missing_key_date_flag. 1 if active, 0 otherwise.

suspicious_value_flag.description: Binary quality/schedule flag: suspicious_value_flag. 1 if active, 0 otherwise.

ministry.description: Categorical feature: ministry. If missing or null, imputed as 'Unknown'.
ministry.example: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways

sector.description: Categorical feature: sector. If missing or null, imputed as 'Unknown'.

implementing_agency.description: Categorical feature: implementing_agency. If missing or null, imputed as 'Unknown'.

state.description: Categorical feature: state. If missing or null, imputed as 'Unknown'.
